To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the medicinal and aromatic plants have the potential to be used as pesticides and that the use of these plant-based pesticides is environmentally friendly.

(i) medicinal and aromatic plants (MAPs) can be a major source of pesticides; (ii) MAPs are a major source of green pesticides/risk-reduced pesticides; and (iii) MAPs can also be used as pesticides in the form of herbal pesticides.
the use of plant extracts is a promising alternative for the control of pests and diseases in crops.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of green pesticides, which is a sustainable and eco-friendly alternative to the conventional pesticides.
the development of new and safer pesticides, which are based on natural products and which are less toxic than conventional pesticides.
the development of green pesticides and the reduction of risk pesticides.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the indiscriminate use of pesticides is a threat to the environment and human health [5].
pesticides are a boon for the agricultural sector but they are a curse for human health and the environment.
the use of synthetic pesticides in agriculture is not sustainable and has to be reduced [5,6].
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of plant-based pesticides is a promising alternative to synthetic chemical pesticides.
the medicinal and aromatic plants are the major source of green pesticides/risk-reduced pesticides.
the use of pesticides in the developing countries is a major cause of the health problems.
The main takeaway from our work is that

there is a need to develop and promote the use of green pesticides, which are eco-friendly and risk-reduced pesticides, to replace the use of conventional pesticides in order to minimize the adverse effects on human health and the environment.
we have shown that the use of medicinal plants as biopesticides is a viable alternative to chemical pesticides.
the use of pesticides is a major cause of environmental and public health problems.
